description: This file defines the SavingsApplicationTestBuilder class used for constructing JSON payloads for savings application tests in the Fineract project. It provides methods to set various parameters and generate JSON strings for testing savings account applications.

classes.name: SavingsApplicationTestBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating JSON payloads for savings account application tests, allowing configuration of parameters like submitted date, external ID, withdrawal fees, and arrays of clients and savings.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string representing a savings application request based on set parameters, for either a client or a group and specified savings product.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string representing a general savings application payload with client and savings arrays.

methods.name: withSubmittedOnDate
methods.description: Sets the submission date for the savings application.

methods.name: withExternalId
methods.description: Sets the external ID for the savings application.

methods.name: withWithdrawalFeeForTransfers
methods.description: Configures whether withdrawal fees apply for transfers.

methods.name: withParams
methods.description: Sets additional parameters for the application.

methods.name: withDatatables
methods.description: Sets datatables data for the application.

methods.name: withClientArray
methods.description: Sets the client array for the application.

methods.name: withSavingsArray
methods.description: Sets the savings array for the application.
